MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The smart plug feels useful because it would let me control a lamp through the Echo devices I already own, adding a function to my setup.",
    "The Alexa-compatible suggestions connect with my recent Echo purchases; that connection matters most when an item helps me do something new with those devices."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Fire TV sticks and most Echo suggestions repeat needs covered by my recent 4K Max, fourth-generation Dot, and second-generation Show 5. Older versions give me little reason to choose them now.",
    "The internal SSDs assume an upgrade project I have not shown a need for. My external-drive purchase does not establish that either internal drive fits my computer.",
    "The memory-card-and-reader bundle overlaps with my existing multi-format USB 3.0 reader, and I have no immediate need for another bundle."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying Echo and Fire TV devices seems to have been treated as an ongoing desire for more speakers, displays, and streaming sticks, even though my recent purchases already cover those uses.",
    "My storage and computer-accessory purchases seem to have been taken as interest in any related hardware, without enough attention to its purpose or compatibility."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent device purchases matter because they can satisfy a need, reducing my interest in another item that does the same job.",
    "My Show 5 stand and Harmony replacement batteries suggest that accessories supporting equipment I already own can be more useful to me than another main device.",
    "I need a concrete use and confirmed compatibility before an internal storage upgrade feels relevant."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognize my connected-home and computer interests but miss that I currently value useful additions to existing equipment more than duplicate devices or unplanned upgrades."
}
